units.source_text: 她草草地和了一首诗，叫宰相君传言，自己便回进内室去了。

en.t: She hastily composed a reply poem, had Saisho no Kimi deliver the message, and then went back into the inner room.

units.source_text: 兵部卿亲王为了玉鬘对他疏远冷淡，心中不胜怨恨，又诉了许多苦。

en.t: Prince Hyobukyo, deeply resentful that Tamakazura treated him so distantly and coldly, poured out many more complaints.

units.source_text: 但逗留过久，似乎太好色了，

en.t: But staying too long would make him seem excessively lovesick,

units.source_text: 便在夜深天色未明、檐前苦雨淋漓之时，不管襟袖濡湿，告辞出门而去。

en.t: so, deep in the night before dawn, while the cold rain streamed down before the eaves, he took his leave and went out, heedless of his damp collar and sleeves.
Perhaps at just that moment a cuckoo was crying as if it were weeping blood.

units.source_text: 为避免烦琐，恕不描写了。

en.t: To avoid needless detail, I will refrain from describing it further.
